{{Top|leg}}
A '''reaction car''' was a [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle]] used on [[Rhamsis Callo]] by the native [[Schenor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were fast and powerful, but not particularly safe or nimble, and not at all compact, quiet, or efficient. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] team that was delivering the young Schenor [[A'kazz]] to his [[nest-guild]] used a reaction car to transport the youth from the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] at [[Chafflock]], avoiding attempts by local Imperials to waylay them on their way to A'kazz's [[nest-guildmaster]], [[B'karitz]].<ref name="SW">{{WEGCite|story=The Silent Witness|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Reaction cars were described in "[[The Silent Witness]]" as resembling massive 1960s [[Wikipedia:Cadillac|Cadillacs]].<ref name="SW" />
